description:
Director Lance Oppenheim sits down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Mark Ellis to talk about his upcoming thriller, 'Primetime'!  He talks about plucking the script from obscurity to explore the themes of how people become "personas", his facination with how Chris Hansen turned incredibly dark subject matter into entertainment ('To Catch a Predator'), and how his film is a portrait of a complicated hero.  See 'Primetime' in theaters September 25!
